entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Isaac, I need to return this VeloBand GPS tracker. I'm looking at my order, and I've had it for 39 days and I want my money back. Now.

I can certainly look into that return for you. To get started, can I have your name and order number please? Also, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the device? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

The issue is I don't want it anymore! It's that simple. And don't you dare give me some runaround that it's **too late** or some nonsense about **hygiene** and **sanitation** risks. Your own website **policy** is crystal clear: 90 days. I want to start the return.
I understand completely. No problem at all. Let me just pull up your account with that order number. One moment.
Okay, I have your order pulled up. And you are correct, you received the item 39 days ago, which is well within our 90-day return policy. I can absolutely process this for you.
Oh. So you're just... approving it? No fight?

That's correct. You're within the policy window, so I've just initiated the return. I've sent a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file. Just pack the item in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method.
Wow. Okay. Well, that was easier than I expected. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
